errors.evidence: The description uses three extremely long sentences to give a point-by-point readout of each line's trajectory. This level of detail, combined with the complex sentence structure, makes the description difficult to read and less concise than a summary of the overall trends.
The description does not explicitly mention the presence of a legend at the top of the chart, which is used to identify the three data series. The reference description includes this detail.
